about: Labelled changes for the tamper guard (ADR 0042). expect lists the kinds of finding a case must give; an empty list means none. Each case is a git repo whose main branch has base and whose working tree on a branch has head (null deletes a file).

cases.note: The test and its assertion are gone; sub still exists.
